title: Rescuers recover bodies after flood at illegal Indonesia gold mine
html:
Rescuers recover bodies after flood at illegal Indonesia gold mine

At least 13 miners died and others remain missing after heavy rain flooded an illegal gold mine in West Java, Indonesia. The workers were trapped around 100 metres underground after torrential rain caused a river to overflow.
summary: At least 13 miners died and others remain missing after heavy rain flooded an illegal gold mine in West Java, Indonesia.
